Name: Recoloring your Buildings
Author: mrhacwer
Description:
This mod allows you to choose the colors of almost all your structures inside Robin's store.

You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.0.2[/url]

Examples:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ey4zNAq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/DgogIlm.png[/img]

Structures that you can now change the color of are All Barns, All Coops, Mill, Shed, Silo, Slime Hutch and Well.

This mod can be used in any language.
